decision_rule: serial is chosen unless a package's serial wall time exceeds its reviewed budget AND a bounded shard/merge design meets all five conditions; no CephFS-safe ledger rewrite is implemented

r1_t22_calibration.basis: 690 confirmation cells x archived measured 203/322/561 s at n_files=4/8/16 (same pipeline and allocation as T22-S reduced) + 32 pilot cells; low/high from the archived per-cell median spread

sharding.why_not: serial fits the reviewed 72 h anchor within the measured spread; sharding requires a target-filesystem locking validation that does not exist, and the base instructions forbid speculative infrastructure expansion when serial meets the budget

r1_t22_calibration.lock_rewrite_note: no CephFS-safe ledger rewrite is implemented or depended on; the archived advisory flock is used serially. A parallel-safe ledger remains a separate reviewed engineering item (old F8), not a dependency of this science package
r1_t22_calibration.fallback: serial one-worker execution; failed cells are charged and retried only with --allow-repeat
r1_t22_calibration.rationale: R1 is the expected borderline case: ~73 h serial against a 72 h anchor (~3 days). It is decided SERIAL because it does not materially exceed the reviewed budget, the parallel alternative is unreviewed, and a failed locking claim would corrupt the ledger. If a later review approves a target-filesystem-validated parallel ledger, the wall time could fall to ~5 h but only as a separately tested engineering change.

r2_t20_theta012.basis: 966-cell required matrix; measured production fit cells 1.74/3.46/6.73 s at N=400/800/1600 (d=256, R=4), projected ~1.4e4 CPU-s

sharding.why_not: well within the 2-8 h anchor; serial is sufficient

r2_t20_theta012.rationale: Required matrix is small; the optional theta=0.40 geometry is a costed expansion and is not required for the claimed scope.

r3_t21_finite.basis: measured BENCHMARK.json cell compute 816.9 s for 3456 fits at d=256/512/1024, plus unmeasured harness/reduce bounded by the cell count

sharding.why_not: far below the <= 7 h anchor; serial is sufficient

r3_t21_finite.rationale: Targeted fixed-gamma ladder; the measured cell compute is minutes, so no parallel infrastructure is warranted.

r4_t22_feasibility.basis: module (a) 320 cells 102->1000 s at n_files 4->64 (50 MC) ~34.6 h + module (b) 240 cells at n=16 ~18.7 h; n=32/64 removal saves ~25 h

sharding.why_not: serial fits the 67 h anchor and the screening can reduce it; serial is sufficient

r1_cancellation_gate.effect: if R1's frozen outcome fails the precondition, the n_files=32/64 cells are CANCELLED (not deferred), an R4_INFEASIBLE receipt is emitted, and the cells are omitted from the launch plan and cost report

r4_t22_feasibility.rationale: The old 67 h estimate omitted the development-gate module; R4 now costs the two modules separately and cancels large-file cells when R1 fails.

r5_t19_reach.basis: 4 cells x 20 independent seeds over the 10.2-million-sample grid at d=256; projected from the d=32 fixture by sample-count x dimension scaling, NOT measured at production m
r5_t19_reach.measurement_note: a production-calibration pilot cell must be measured before the multi-million-sample allocation is priced; the projection is a planning bound only

sharding.why_not: optional package, well within the 3-6 h anchor even at the upper projection; serial is sufficient

r5_t19_reach.fallback: serial one-worker execution; bounded memory keeps the allocation safe
r5_t19_reach.rationale: R5 is optional. Bounded-memory accumulation means memory is O(chunk*d + d^2), so no storage-driven parallelism is needed.
